K-S2.text: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.

K-C.text: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.

K-G4.text: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.

RESULT.text: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN.
